needed_streams: Independent zone air-temperature reference (e.g., adjacent-zone sensor, return-air sensor, or the controller-side thermostat reading); zone thermal/electric load (Zone_F3_Z01_Electric_Power_Sensor / zone cooling coil energy); AHU/VAV damper actual and VAV airflow for that zone; outside-air and supply-air temperature for the same period. Without those, a sensor drift and a real local-load increase produce indistinguishable signatures in the single F3_Z01 zone-temperature stream that is available.

content.text: The data shows F3_Z01's temperature rose moderately since July 2018 (+0.63 °C vs. several other zones that also rose), but with no independent temperature reference for the zone, no zone load stream (Zone_F3_Z01_Electric_Power_Sensor exists in the graph but is not exposed in the catalog), and the controller's own thermostat sensor excluded by the question, I can't distinguish a genuine local-load increase from a sensor drift / fault.

input.needed_streams: Independent zone air-temperature reference (e.g., adjacent-zone sensor, return-air sensor, or the controller-side thermostat reading); zone thermal/electric load (Zone_F3_Z01_Electric_Power_Sensor / zone cooling coil energy); AHU/VAV damper actual and VAV airflow for that zone; outside-air and supply-air temperature for the same period. Without those, a sensor drift and a real local-load increase produce indistinguishable signatures in the single F3_Z01 zone-temperature stream that is available.
